subject: RECORD clause
notes: ONE printed sentence, TWO obligations, TWO rows - 'neither records that contain a lesser number of bytes than that specified by integer-2 NOR records that contain a greater number of bytes than that specified by integer-3' - and a negative golden per arm, because a rule read as one predicate gets one screen and the other arm ships silent (the kb/Work PB743 shape, applied before the defect). The sizes compared are 13.18.43.4 GR8 a) for the lower arm (every occurs-depending table at its MINIMUM occurrences) and GR8 b) for the upper. RecordClauseRuleDriftTests.Sr4StatesTwoObligations_AndTheTableHasARowForEachArm re-derives the split from the printed rule, so a rule that grows a third obligation turns red. The positive golden pins the upper boundary where the rule must NOT fire (a 20-byte record under FROM 0 TO 20).
